details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11291-11292 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion, the success path ignores a failure of `post_state_comment` (`post_state_comment || true`), so the once-per-head ledger `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas` may never be persisted.
  WHY: If that state-comment POST fails and the `mark_validation_complete` call later in the same tick also leaves no persisted state, the next tick rebuilds the old state (marker present, ledger empty) and resumes the same head SHA again, which breaks the issue's item 4 once-per-head rule. Severity: the source rated this NIT, mapped here to low. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite raised the same site only as hardening suggestions.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion (comprehensive_cycle_aborted and head_not_validated skips; refs lines 17635, 16077-16079) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The reason `lookup_failed` is used for two permanent outcomes decided from local state with no API call: `comprehensive_cycle_aborted` and `head_not_validated`. As a result, every exhausted comprehensive-cycle project logs `reason=lookup_failed detail=comprehensive_cycle_aborted` on every tick.
  WHY: The `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME` prefix is contractual, and `lookup_failed` means a transient failure. Using it here makes a fixed park that needs a person look like API trouble that will clear by itself. Using `not_final_merge_exhausted` instead would keep the meaning intact. This is a log-meaning problem, not a control-flow bug. Severity: the source rated this NIT, mapped here to low.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11154-11159 (and /judge_resume handler 29707-29712) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The validation-failure label check is documented as guarding against a validation failure recorded after the park (for example after /judge_resume). But /judge_resume clears `.final_merge_failure_kind` at line 29710, so the marker check at line 11150 returns `not_final_merge_exhausted` first. The label check can only fire when a person sets the label by hand.
  WHY: The function still fails closed, so this is a mismatch between the documentation (the agents.d fragment's "supersedes" claim) and the code, not a runtime defect. Severity: the source rated this NIT, mapped here to low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #9320 item 4: "Stop after one try per head SHA. Record each final-PR head SHA that has had an automatic retry. If the retry fails again, the project re-parks normally, and no further automatic retry happens until the PR's head changes."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion moved-head check at lines 11212-11216 (`if [ "${fmar_head_sha}" != "${fmar_validated_sha}" ]; then _final_merge_auto_resume_skip "lookup_failed" "head_not_validated"`), the failed-project terminal-state flow (lines 29778-29793), and a path that re-validates a changed head or records a validation pass for it
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `validation_last_passed_sha` is written only inside mark_validation_complete (lines 17571-17578 / 17574), which a parked `failed` project never reaches on a new head. A head that differs from the validated SHA is skipped at lines 11212-11216. The terminal block (29760-29793) leaves the project failed and dispatches nothing for it. No hunk dispatches validation for a moved head or clears the park. The last run only changed the skip label (`validation_not_recorded detail=head_moved` → `lookup_failed detail=head_not_validated`). It also rewrote README item 14 and the variable row, the changelog fragment, the agents.d fragment and the tracking-comment text to say a new head "stays parked until a person intervenes", which is the opposite of item 4. workflow-templates/ai-workflow-integrity.yml (lines 17-21) runs only on pull_request_target opened/synchronize/reopened and on push, so on a parked PR the integrity status usually turns green only after a new head. /judge_resume clears `.final_merge_failure_kind` (line 29710), which permanently rules out the auto-resume path. The issue's out-of-scope list (`MAX_FINAL_MERGE_ATTEMPTS`, `ai:force-merge`, budget-ineligible deferrals) does not defer this, so the editor's "TASK_GAP_DEFERRED" note has no backing in the issue. Reviewers disagree on the motivating incident: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 say shubhodeep1/fun-token-multi-chain#579/#596 is affected, while z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says it is still covered because its head never changed.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion (`_final_merge_auto_resume_skip "lookup_failed" "comprehensive_cycle_aborted"` and `_final_merge_auto_resume_skip "lookup_failed" "head_not_validated"`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The reason `lookup_failed` is used for permanent, local-state outcomes. The exhaustion path (line 17635) always runs `handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed "failed"`, which writes `{handled: true, status: "failed"}` (lines 16077-16079), so every exhausted comprehensive-cycle project logs `reason=lookup_failed detail=comprehensive_cycle_aborted` on every tick.
  WHY: Anyone watching the contractual `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME` prefix will read these as transient API trouble that will clear on its own. Using `not_final_merge_exhausted` would keep the meaning of `lookup_failed` intact. This is a log-meaning problem, not a control-flow bug.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Issue #9320 item 4: "If the retry fails again, the project re-parks normally, and no further automatic retry happens until the PR's head changes." The motivating case is shubhodeep1/fun-token-multi-chain#579 / final PR #596.
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion head-mismatch branch (`_final_merge_auto_resume_skip "lookup_failed" "head_not_validated"`). Something has to make a new head eligible, for example sending the project back to validation for that head.
  Evidence of absence: `validation_last_passed_sha` is written only in mark_validation_complete (line 17574). No hunk dispatches validation for a moved head or clears the park. README item 14, the changelog fragment, the agents.d fragment and the tracking-comment text say "a new head stays parked until a person intervenes". workflow-templates/ai-workflow-integrity.yml (lines 17-21) triggers only on pull_request_target opened/synchronize/reopened and on push. The out-of-scope list does not defer this, so the editor's "TASK_GAP_DEFERRED" note has no backing. Refusing to merge an unvalidated head should stay.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1):
  - scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion success path `post_state_comment || true`: if the state comment fails, labels have changed but the persisted state is stale and the head ledger may be lost. Fix: emit a `::warning::FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME ... state not persisted after resume` on failure (3 lines).
  - scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion label-failure rollback `mv "${fmar_state_backup}" "${STATE_FILE}" 2>/dev/null || true`: a failed restore is not logged. Fix: replace `|| true` with a `::warning::... could not restore state after label failure` echo (1 line).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  Requirement: "If the retry fails again, the project re-parks normally, and no further automatic retry happens until the PR's head changes." (Issue #9320 item 4)
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion
  Evidence of absence: The implementation parks any PR head that does not match the validated SHA (`if [ "${fmar_head_sha}" != "${fmar_validated_sha}" ]; then _final_merge_auto_resume_skip "lookup_failed" "head_not_validated"`). A new head that is green and mergeable stays parked because it cannot already be validated. The logic treats a head change as a permanent park that needs a person.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1): scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion success path after set_tracking_phase_label "ai:validated". The issue is a post_state_comment failure after the label write succeeds. Fix: log a warning and return 0 (3 lines).
